ayahs.tj: إِذَا ٱلسَّمَآءُ ٱنفَطَرَتْ ١

ayahs.en: And when the stars fall, scattering,
And when the seas are erupted
And when the [contents of] graves are scattered,

ayahs.tj: عَلِمَتْ نَفْسٌ مَّا قَدَّمَتْ وَأَخَّرَتْ ٥
ayahs.en: A soul will [then] know what it has put forth and kept back.

ayahs.ar: يٰأَيُّهَا الإِنسٰنُ ما غَرَّكَ بِرَبِّكَ الكَريمِ
ayahs.tj: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ مَا غَرَّكَ بِرَبِّكَ ٱلْكَرِيمِ ٦
ayahs.en: O mankind, what has deceived you concerning your Lord, the Generous,

ayahs.tj: ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَكَ فَسَوَّٮٰكَ فَعَدَلَكَ ٧
ayahs.en: Who created you, proportioned you, and balanced you?

ayahs.ar: فى أَىِّ صورَةٍ ما شاءَ رَكَّبَكَ
ayahs.tj: فِىٓ أَىِّ صُورَةٍ مَّا شَآءَ رَكَّبَكَ ٨
ayahs.en: In whatever form He willed has He assembled you.

ayahs.tj: كَلَّا بَلْ تُكَذِّبُونَ بِٱلدِّينِ ٩
ayahs.en: No! But you deny the Recompense.

ayahs.tj: وَإِنَّ عَلَيْكُمْ لَحَـٰفِظِينَ ١٠
ayahs.en: And indeed, [appointed] over you are keepers,

ayahs.tj: إِنَّ ٱلْأَبْرَارَ لَفِى نَعِيمٍ ١٣
ayahs.en: Indeed, the righteous will be in pleasure,

ayahs.tj: وَإِنَّ ٱلْفُجَّارَ لَفِى جَحِيمٍ ١٤
ayahs.en: And indeed, the wicked will be in Hellfire.
They will [enter to] burn therein on the Day of Recompense,

ayahs.tj: وَمَا هُمْ عَنْهَا بِغَآئِبِينَ ١٦
ayahs.en: And never therefrom will they be absent.

ayahs.tj: وَمَآ أَدْرَٮٰكَ مَا يَوْمُ ٱلدِّينِ ١٧
ayahs.en: And what can make you know what is the Day of Recompense?

ayahs.ar: ثُمَّ ما أَدرىٰكَ ما يَومُ الدّينِ
ayahs.tj: ثُمَّ مَآ أَدْرَٮٰكَ مَا يَوْمُ ٱلدِّينِ ١٨
ayahs.en: Then, what can make you know what is the Day of Recompense?

ayahs.ar: يَومَ لا تَملِكُ نَفسٌ لِنَفسٍ شَيـًٔا وَالأَمرُ يَومَئِذٍ لِلَّهِ
ayahs.tj: يَوْمَ لَا تَمْلِكُ نَفْسٌ لِّنَفْسٍ شَيْــًٔا‌ۖ وَٱلْأَمْرُ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلَّهِ ١٩
ayahs.en: It is the Day when a soul will not possess for another soul [power to do] a thing; and the command, that Day, is [entirely] with Allah.
